import torch

def forward(module, x, w, b):
    # im2col for non-overlapping 16x16 stride-16 patches
    x = x.reshape(1, 3, 14, 16, 14, 16).permute(0, 2, 4, 1, 3, 5)
    cols = x.reshape(196, 768)
    w2d = w.reshape(768, 768)
    # low-rank factorization W ≈ U V^T, rank r
    U, S, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(w2d, full_matrices=False)
    r = module.rank
    U = U[:, :r] * S[:r]
    V = Vh[:r, :]
    out = (cols @ V.t()) @ U.t()          # 196x768
    out = out + b
    return out.reshape(1, 768, 14, 14)

import torch.nn.functional as F

def forward(module, x):
    # x: (B, 784, 768) tokens from the linear, or already (B, 768, 28, 28)
    if x.dim() == 3:
        B, N, C = x.shape
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, C, 28, 28)
    else:
        B, C = x.shape[0], x.shape[1]
    y = F.interpolate(x, size=(56, 56), mode='bilinear', align_corners=False)
    y = y.reshape(B, C, 56 * 56).transpose(1, 2).contiguous()
    return y
